goal: Visual per-country execution feedback in Calibración: animated 'Ejecutándose' badge on card + list row, and a page-header chip counting running countries.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A reusable RunStatusBadge component renders an 'Ejecutándose' badge with a spinning Loader2 icon when job status is 'running' or 'pending', and renders the existing Completed/Failed/Cancelled badges for those statuses (visual parity with today).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest unit test: render RunStatusBadge for each status ('pending','running','completed','failed','cancelled', undefined) and assert badge text + presence/absence of animate-spin class. npm test passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CountryCard shows the running badge while a calibration job is running/pending, in the same status-badge slot; CountryListRow shows it in the Resultado column (which today is empty while running).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright e2e: start mock (npm run mock:fast), trigger calibration for one country, assert badge with text 'Ejecutándose' is visible in both cards view and list view before the job completes; after completion assert 'Completed' badge appears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CalibrationPage header shows a chip '<N> en ejecución' with the flags of the running countries when at least one job is running/pending, and the chip is absent when none are running.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright e2e: before triggering, assert chip not present; trigger calibration for a country, assert chip visible with count 1 and that country's flag; after job completes, assert chip disappears.
npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b, then MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast against mock:fast + dev:e2e.

tasks.desc: Create shared RunStatusBadge component (src/modules/calibracion/components/RunStatusBadge.tsx or src/components if trivially generic) with unit tests; covers pending/running (spinner) + completed/failed/cancelled (current visuals).
Wire RunStatusBadge into CountryCard (replace the three inline status badges) and CountryListRow (Resultado column).
Add RunningCountriesChip in CalibrationPage header next to ViewToggle: derives running countries from the same /calibration/runs query data; hidden when zero.
Playwright e2e specs for ac2 + ac3 (smoke project, using mock:fast + dev:e2e), then full VERIFY_CMD.
